title: The Safehouse of the Green Zone
author: Ada Nakamura
blurb: Noor Yarrow, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, works cases no one wants attributed. But when every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must extract a defector who may be the bait before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
